visual.general_description: Three vertically stacked echocardiography screen captures (A, B, C), each with a small sector image and a spectral Doppler display with printed aortic valve measurements.
visual.detailed_description: Panel A and panel B share one on-screen layout with a measurement box at top right; panel C uses a different layout with a measurement list at top left. Every panel prints velocity values, pressure gradients and velocity-time integrals as overlay text, and each spectral display has one beat envelope outlined. Panel B also prints aortic valve area values. See the panel rows for the transcribed printed text.

panels.general_description: Echocardiography screen capture with a sector image, a spectral Doppler display and printed measurements.
panels.detailed_description: Printed top-left machine settings: FR 13Hz, 24cm, 2D 77%, C 52, P Low, HGen, CF 77%, 2.5MHz, WF High, Med. Measurement box headed AV VTI prints Vmax 265 cm/s, Vmean 177 cm/s, Max PG 28 mmHg, Mean PG 15 mmHg and VTI 45.3 cm. Spectral Doppler display with a green ECG trace along its top edge, a velocity scale printed in cm/s with tick labels 100, -100, -200 and -300, and one beat envelope outlined by a white dotted line with cross markers. Color scale at right printed +51.3 and -51.3 cm/s; panel letter A printed at top left.

visual.general_description: Eight CT slices (A to H) of the transcatheter aortic valve arranged in two columns, each under a printed column header (exam date), and four rows, with red arrows in the left column only.
visual.detailed_description: A printed column header (exam date) sits above each of the left and right columns. Rows one and two (A to D) are short-axis slices with a white circle labelled RC, NC and LC; rows three and four (E to H) are long-axis slices of the valve. Red hollow arrows appear in panels A, C, E and G; none are drawn in B, D, F or H. Some panels carry printed Phase or Distance text and partly cropped text at the right edge.
